solubility_in_water.note: Miscible with water. The values are for pure (glacial) acid; vinegar is about 5 % acetic acid.

hazards.summary: Glacial acetic acid burns skin and is flammable. Vinegar is safe to handle.
hazards.source: General-chemistry reference values recalled from memory; check a supplier data sheet or handbook before teaching use.

storage: Closed container away from heat and oxidisers.

reactions.note: Only a small fraction of molecules ionise in water (pKa about 4.8).
Reacts with bases and with carbonates, releasing carbon dioxide.

educational_notes: Because it is a weak acid, 0.1 mol/L acetic acid has a pH of about 2.9, far less acidic than 0.1 mol/L hydrochloric acid.
